header: Where shops help each other while we are on another call
lead: Four places at four different speeds. Most of it is already written down in the forum; the things nobody writes down come up at the Stammtisch.
note: Member counts are rounded and checked twice a year, so read them as an order of magnitude rather than as a figure.

places.title: User forum
places.description: About 1,400 shops. Reading needs no account, and most questions have been answered there once already.

places.title: Kassenstammtisch Linz
places.description: First Wednesday of the month, 7pm, a different pub each time. Nobody signs up, people simply come.

places.title: API mailing list
places.description: Around 120 subscribers and one or two mails a month, for anybody connecting something of their own.

places.title: The API client source
places.description: The PHP and Python clients are public. We would rather have a bug report than see a workaround built.
